The map shows '@' at (2,7) and 'P' at (3,7). The notice board 'o' is at (7,6) in this view — wait, that's the gold door. The notice board at (2,7) isn't shown as 'o' here. So (2,7) is walkable and I'm on it. But I can't move right to (3,7) because the player is there.

Let me move up to (2,6) instead.
